newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower across the board in the after-hours session on Friday, pressured by selling from trade houses, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 1.4 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.5 yen weaker at 140.0 yen. Volume was 5,364 lots.

During the day, relatively cheaper prices in Kobe compared with levels in producing countries, prompted investors to buy distant months, but lingering concerns over near-term oversupply continued to pressure nearby months, they said.
The market is closed on Monday for a public holiday.
